name: 86305 · Prescott, AZ
findings: ZIP 86305 (Prescott) has 85 nonprofit organizations. 35 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 29 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (43% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 86305 (Prescott) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
